card.name: The word first in early-treatment windows
card.fires_on: The word "first" right after "the" in phrases like "within the first" or "during the first", before a time span such as 24-72 hours, months or a year of therapy.

modes.label: Early-period risk window
modes.description: "first" after within/during/to the, opening a time span in which a risk is highest.
modes.example: Monitor patients closely for respiratory depression, especially within the<< first>> 24 to 72 hours

modes.label: First meal or other first item
modes.description: "first" before a dosing event such as the first meal of the day.
modes.example: taken before the<< first>> meal of the day.

card.writes: It seems to push toward time-span and name-like continuations and away from words like follow, isolation and screening.
card.plain: It marks the word "first" when a label talks about the early days or months of treatment.
